_doc: Diesel Domestiques sprites (brief 3; docs/ART_PIPELINE.md), 61 ids. Strips wider than 3:1 are tile + mirror segments; the hulls and boss_hull beyond 3:1 are requested at 3:1 with the subject filling the width, so the trimmed result keeps the sprite's aspect (ADR 'Art sizes beyond 3:1'). Placeholders from src/games/tank/view/placeholder_art.gd stand in for every id until an art pass with WATTLANDS_ALLOW_ART.
style: Side-view 2D game asset in strict orthographic side elevation, painted as a moody matte concept-art diorama: big simple readable shapes, soft smooth shading with gentle gradients, no outlines, not pixel art, no fine noise or tiny clutter. Low-key and desaturated: soot grey-black, gunmetal, rust brown and mud with deep shadows; the only saturated colours are lights, which glow softly: warm amber fire and lamp light, or cold blue-white arc light. Dark brutalist alternate-history 1940s: massive riveted steel slabs, soot, rust, mud, wet surfaces catching light. Show only what the description names, centered. No people, figures or faces; no text, letters, numbers, flags, insignia, emblems, markings or logos.
notes: Lights are the only near-saturated colours (warm #e8743a #ffb35c #ffd99a #fff3d6; cold #5d86a3 #9fc4dd #e6f3fb). Wall lamps and shape badges are white sprites tinted at runtime in the rider's colour.
